notes.title: Huge graphic overhaul for Juna - The Dreamwalker
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44400707/ec164bc5679b2b95be4d6bfd6cbedd155e8ad06e.jpg[/img]
[h1]Big Update: Massive Graphic Overhaul Now Live!
[/h1]
We are thrilled to announce our latest update, delivering a comprehensive graphical overhaul to enhance your gaming experience! This update is packed with significant visual improvements, performance optimizations, and crucial bug fixes.

[h2]Enhanced New Graphics[/h2]
Every aspect of the game has been meticulously redrawn, from the main menu to the end credits. Immerse yourself in a beautifully refreshed world with vibrant colors and sharper details.

With this update, you now have the option to switch from the classic 16-pixel tile graphics to 32-pixel tile graphics. This new option doubles the resolution of in-game tiles, offering a richer and more detailed visual experience.
Check out the comparison images below:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44400707/d5cfc119cc9955122f9cb447049991d221f67d40.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44400707/626803ea114281b907cd44e7a11416e08305677d.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44400707/331f51833bb1dcf7fc1370cdafbe25525e793908.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44400707/6db833fe5bac1207706693e9518b16cd3ca38c88.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44400707/90cb3d6baf89c2ecf980de009620c0e643a86fbb.png[/img]

[h2]Performance Optimizations[/h2]
We’ve made several under-the-hood improvements to ensure smoother gameplay. Enjoy faster load times, reduced lag, and a more responsive experience overall.

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
This update addresses numerous bugs reported by our community. Key fixes include:
- Resolved an issue where the game would crash during certain scenes.
- Fixed graphical glitches that occurred on specific occasions.
- Memory usage halved

Thank you for your continued support and feedback. We hope you enjoy this massive update and look forward to hearing your thoughts. Dive back into the game and experience the new visuals today!

[b]Update your game now and see the difference![/b]
